$comment: Test files under scripts/tests/ or scripts/ci/tests/ that no CI workflow
every *.test.{mjs,ts,sh} file directly under those two directories must be
wired into a `run:` step in .github/workflows/ or listed here.
kind 'cannot-run-in-ci' = needs a database, the VPS, a live external site,
or a credential CI does not have. kind 'broken' = cannot currently run or
pass anywhere; it needs a tracking issue, because a broken test hiding
inside 'excluded' is exactly the silence this gate exists to end
Paths must name one file exactly, under scripts/tests/ or scripts/ci/tests/

exclusions.reason: The self-test is a real defect finder, not a broken test: audit-ipo-coverage.mjs's subRows SELECT is missing face_value, authoritative_issue_price and company_website, which three SUBSTANCE_CHECKS predicates read — those predicates silently no-op on every row today. Wiring this into CI now would fail every PR on a pre-existing production defect it did not cause. Excluded until the SELECT is fixed (issue #1173), then it wires in as a normal pass.
